conversationInvite.description: Notifies a recipient that a conversation has been started with them. One per conversation per direction. recipientId must name an identity that exists, and every property is frozen at creation.

conversationId.description: Compact conversation ID (first 10 bytes of hash of sorted participant IDs)

senderPubKey.description: Optional: sender's compressed public key for ECDH. Only needed if sender's on-chain identity uses hash160 keys.

directMessage.description: A message in a conversation. Lean - no recipientId, no read status. The conversation index is rangeCountable, so per-conversation totals and "unread since lastReadAt" are count queries. Both properties are frozen at creation.

conversationId.description: Compact conversation ID (first 10 bytes of hash of sorted participant IDs)

encryptedContent.description: Binary encrypted message: first 12 bytes = IV, remaining = ciphertext.

readReceipt.description: One per (owner, conversation), replaced to bump $updatedAt whenever the owner reads it. conversationId is frozen, so a replace can only move the read time.
